properties.site-address: Development Site At Ergon House Horseferry Road And 9 Millbank London
properties.notes: GLA. Demolition of Ergon House and construction of eight storey residential building incorporating a ground floor retail unit (Class A1) and partial demolition and reconstruction of rear wing of 9 Millbank and conversion to residential use to provide 161 residential flats. Conversion of the gatehouse on Dean Bradley Street to provide a single dwelling unit. Provision of basement car parking and landscaped courtyards.. http://idoxpa.westminster.gov.uk/online-applications/applicationDetails.do?activeTab=summary&keyVal=MTY4L5RPZ5000
